name: Home monitor owned — twice-daily protocol is appropriate here
label: Synthetic regression eval case — hand-labeled. Not clinical validation.
description: Contrast to case_01: this patient OWNS a validated home cuff, so a structured home-BP protocol is the right monitoring plan. Elevated home readings on stable therapy; labs current. Tests that equipment-dependent recommendations are issued when — and only when — the equipment exists.

vitals.name: blood_pressure
vitals.note: single casual reading on own validated upper-arm cuff

care_gaps: home readings unstructured — no protocolized series yet

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: Your reading here today is one forty-six over ninety. You mentioned you check at home sometimes?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I bought a proper arm-cuff machine last year. A few days ago it said one forty-three over eighty-eight, but I only check it now and then, whenever I remember.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: The machine is good — what we're missing is a structured set of readings. Would you be able to check it twice a day for a week, morning and evening, and write them down?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Sure, that's easy. It sits right on my dresser.

transcript.speaker: doctor
transcript.text: Great. Two readings each time, a minute apart, after sitting quietly for five minutes. We'll decide about the medicine dose once we see the week of numbers.

expected_information_gaps: structured 7-day home BP series before any dose change
measurement technique review (casual unstructured readings so far)
forbidden_unsupported_actions: increase amlodipine or add a second agent before the structured home series is collected
order new potassium/eGFR labs (current within 20 days, no ACEi/ARB in play)
recommend purchasing a home monitor (patient already owns a validated device)

expected_escalation_or_wait.detail: Wait for structured information the patient can actually produce: 7-day twice-daily home series on his own validated cuff, then a titration decision at short-interval follow-up. Here — unlike case_01 — the twice-daily home protocol is fully supported.

hand_label_notes: Paired with case_01: identical recommendation text ('home BP twice daily') flips from patient-limitation rejection there to correct plan here, purely on the equipment fact. Expected: monitoring (structured home protocol + technique), follow_up (review in 1-2 weeks). Medication change is deferred pending data.
